systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Directorate of Community Health; Project BIRCH funded by the Global Fund and implemented by Living Goods
systems.tiers: community level; most ASBCs still on paper tools

note: The document is about the community class: a roadmap co-created on 8-12 September 2025 to digitise community health workers, most of whom work on paper, and to integrate their data into ENDOS, where it states that data is not integrated; it states nothing on ENDOS's own tiers, point of entry, clinics, plan or finance, and the event falls just outside twelve months.
